E1.evidence: Issue ipa320/cob_robots#552 'cob3-9 URDF broken' (floweisshardt, 2016-11-04) quotes the Travis log: "xacro.XacroException: Parameters [has_podest] were not set for macro xacro:schunk_pg70" while roslaunch-check processes cob_bringup/robots/cob3-9.xml, ending in "Invalid <param> tag: Cannot load command parameter [robot_description]: command [/opt/ros/indigo/share/xacro/xacro.py '/home/travis/catkin_ws/src/cob_robots/cob_hardware_config/cob3-9/urdf/cob3-9.urdf.xacro'] returned with code [1]." The maintainer closed it with "fixed in #553"; PR #553 ('fix cob3-9 urdf', 'fixes #552') contains commit b826eae changing the macro call to `<xacro:schunk_pg70 name="pg70" parent="arm_7_link" has_podest="false">`.

E2.evidence: Step 1: schunk_description (package in ipa320/schunk_modular_robotics; provides the xacro macro `schunk_pg70` in urdf/pg70/pg70.urdf.xacro) and cob_hardware_config (package in ipa320/cob_robots; its cob3-9/urdf/cob3-9.urdf.xacro includes that file and calls the macro). Separately released packages from different repositories. Step 2: the failure is the macro call not matching the macro's declared parameter list, a mismatch that crosses the package boundary (the consumer's call is correct against the earlier declaration). Step 3: no deployment names involved. Step 4: not a build-system change; the provider's declaration changed (779ce503: `params="parent name *origin"` -> `params="parent name *origin has_podest"`) and the consumer's source call had to follow. Step 5: no firmware. Step 6: eligible; the interface is the xacro macro signature, recorded as library API.

E3.evidence: UPGRADE: the provider gained a required macro parameter on 2016-11-02 (schunk_modular_robotics PR #177 'New package schunk_pg70', commit 779ce503, merged as 870c6302 on indigo_dev) while the consumer's cob3-9.urdf.xacro, unchanged since 2015-08-11, still calls the macro as declared before that change; the failure appeared when cob_robots' Travis job rebuilt the consumer against the indigo_dev head of the provider. No other operation is supported by the source.

E4.evidence: Observed failure in the source: xacro aborts with XacroException and roslaunch-check reports the robot_description parameter cannot be loaded, so the URDF cannot be generated (dataset: 'the xacro is broken and one can not generate an Urdf out of it anymore').

units.name: schunk_description
units.revision_basis: The failing build is cob_robots' Travis job; its .travis.yml (at 81bf65fd) builds an underlay from ipa320/care-o-bot's indigo_dev .travis.rosinstall (d18ea27a, 2016-10-07), which checks out `https://github.com/ipa320/schunk_modular_robotics.git` at branch indigo_dev. The indigo_dev head from 2016-11-02T19:33:59Z (870c6302, merge of PR #177, whose commit 779ce503 added the has_podest parameter) through the fix on 2016-11-10 was 870c6302; the next commit on indigo_dev is later than 2016-11-11T09:10Z. The resolution does not change this unit. For reference, the parameter is absent from release tag 0.6.8 (2016-10-10) and present in 0.6.9 (2017-07-17).

units.name: cob_hardware_config
units.revision_basis: The issue does not name the cob_robots commit of the failing Travis run; 81bf65fd (2016-10-14, merge of #550) is the indigo_dev head on which the fix PR #553 was based on 2016-11-10, and cob_hardware_config/cob3-9/urdf/cob3-9.urdf.xacro had not been touched since 55b38f62 (2015-08-11), so the consumer file at the failure is the one at 81bf65fd. b826eae ('fix cob3-9 urdf', 2016-11-10T22:25:39Z) is the packet's fix commit, merged to indigo_dev as 1d67d1af on 2016-11-11T09:07:06Z. The roslaunch-check test that failed is declared in cob_bringup of the same repository at the same revision.

failed_conditions.quote: xacro.XacroException: Parameters [has_podest] were not set for macro xacro:schunk_pg70

loudness_evidence: The xacro processor raised `xacro.XacroException: Parameters [has_podest] were not set for macro xacro:schunk_pg70` and roslaunch-check reported "Invalid <param> tag: Cannot load command parameter [robot_description]: command [...xacro.py '.../cob3-9.urdf.xacro'] returned with code [1]." during the catkin test step of the CI build.

resolution.summary: The consumer's macro call passes the new required argument: `<xacro:schunk_pg70 name="pg70" parent="arm_7_link" has_podest="false">` in cob_hardware_config/cob3-9/urdf/cob3-9.urdf.xacro (commit b826eae, PR #553). The provider is unchanged.
resolution.evidence: The maintainer closed the issue with "fixed in #553" (2016-11-10T22:34:53Z) and merged PR #553 on 2016-11-11T09:07:06Z; the source does not show the build output of the fixed composition (GitHub retains no CI status for b826eae or 1d67d1af), so the status is recommended.

notes: Provider declaration before/after (schunk_description/urdf/pg70/pg70.urdf.xacro, commit 779ce503): `-  <xacro:macro name="schunk_pg70" params="parent name *origin">` / `+  <xacro:macro name="schunk_pg70" params="parent name *origin has_podest">`; the new parameter selects between an `<xacro:if value="${has_podest}">` branch that inserts a podest link and an `<xacro:unless>` branch with the old palm joint. The consumer already passed `has_podest="false"` to the sibling macro schunk_lwa4d at the broken revision. consumer_built_against.broken is given as the release tag 0.6.8 (the last released declaration without has_podest); the last indigo_dev commit with the old declaration is 08471b26 (parent of 779ce503). The dataset states the same change broke other parent xacros ('there are several parent-xacro using the child-xacro and one needs to update all the parent-xacros'), but only cob3-9 is documented in the source; the ROBUST reproduction files pair cob_hardware_config 0.6.6 with schunk_description 0.6.9 (broken) and 0.6.8 (working). The same diagnostic would appear at launch time on a robot when upload_robot.launch expands the xacro. PR #553's merge commit 1d67d1af has the same cob3-9.urdf.xacro as b826eae.
